findings.title: Removing `findMany` breaks existing service callers
findings.body: This change removes the public `findMany` method and replaces it with `getBaseConditions`, but the PR does not update any callers. Existing code that calls `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will fail to compile or, if reached dynamically, fail at runtime. Preserve the method with an appropriate raw-query implementation or migrate all callers in this change.
